title: 'Hired to keep her safe from Salman': Ketan Karande recalls brief stint as Aishwarya’s bodyguard

 More than twenty years after Salman Khan and Aishwarya Rai ’s tumultuous breakup became one of Bollywood’s biggest controversies, the infamous chapter is back in the spotlight.

Go Ad Lite Actor and bodybuilder Ketan Karande has reignited the chatter after opening up on a recent podcast about his own brief brush with the drama. Speaking on the YouTube channel Art Media Entertainment, Karande claimed he was once hired to protect Aishwarya from Salman, a job he walked away from within days after a close encounter with the superstar.
 Looking back at the early 2000s, while Aishwarya was shooting Rohan Sippy’s Kuch Naa Kaho opposite Abhishek Bachchan, Karande said he had kept the stint quiet for decades. 
 "Not many know that I was Aishwarya’s bodyguard. I was hired specifically to keep her safe from Salman Khan," he revealed.
 Story continues below. Go Ad Lite Story continues below. Go Ad Lite View this post on Instagram 
 His main responsibility, he explained, was to pick Aishwarya up from her home, ride with her in her car, and ensure she reached her shooting locations safely.
 The turning point came after he escorted Aishwarya to a fashion show hosted by filmmaker Vikram Bhatt. As they left the venue and got into the car, they suddenly came face-to-face with Salman standing right in front of the vehicle. "All of us got scared, wondering what to do," Karande recalled. 
 Bracing for a cold confrontation, he told the driver he would need to step out of the car. The driver, however, urged him to stay put, quickly drifting away from Salman, and zoomed away.
 Shaken by the close encounter, Karande quit the very next day and said he took this decision due to self-preservation and his respect for the two actors. 
 Hinting through gestures that Salman might have been armed, Karande said that he was focused on his bodybuilding career and had no desire to get pulled into a physical altercation.
 As an admirer of both Salman and Aishwarya, he added, he had no interest in getting caught in the middle of a fallout between "two people in love."
 Salman Khan and Aishwarya Rai began dating while filming Sanjay Leela Bhansali’s Hum Dil De Chuke Sanam (1999) before calling it quits in 2002 amid intense media scrutiny and reports of on-set disruptions.
 Neither Aishwarya Rai Bachchan nor Salman Khan has responded to Karande’s remarks and all these claims remain based entirely on his personal experience.
